audited_url_or_path: tanhdev.com (Google Search Console Domain Property: 2026-08-16 to 2026-09-12)

issues.finding: High impression pages in positions 10-25 have low CTR (<1.0%), e.g. /posts/composable-banking-architecture/ (741 impr, 0% CTR, pos 37.5) and /posts/graphhopper-distance-matrix-production-guide/ (212 impr, 0.47% CTR, pos 17.08).
issues.recommendation: Rewrite meta descriptions and H1 titles to include clear value props, benchmark metrics, and CTR hooks (e.g. 'Production Guide', 'Benchmarks', 'Step-by-Step Architecture').

issues.finding: Top impression pillar pages (such as Composable Banking and E-commerce Microservices) need stronger contextual internal links to supporting series parts.
issues.recommendation: Add bidirectional links between high-impression standalone posts and deep series chapters to pass authority and boost average positions from page 2-4 into page 1.

traditional_seo.overall_notes: Domain visibility expanded to 11,296 impressions across 119 countries in 28 days. Average position improved from 41.0 (Week 1) to 23.0 (Week 4).

answer_first_structure.notes: H2 sections with atomic <=60w BLUF blocks are successfully indexed by Google, with multiple H2 fragment anchor links appearing directly in SERP (#graphhopper-the-java-soul... and #osrm-the-c-titan...).

fact_density.notes: High factual density on routing, fintech, and microservices architecture posts.

schema_markup.notes: Connected @graph JSON-LD schema validated across all posts and series.

ai_bot_crawlability.notes: robots.txt verified: OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot, Bingbot permitted.

content_uniqueness.notes: Top 10 SERP non-commodity differentiation verified via empirical benchmarks and real-world failure post-mortems.
